user.title: Connect to Chain2Gate
user.description: Enter the local gateway hostname or IPv4 address. Its MAC address is detected automatically when possible; otherwise you can enter it manually.

discovery_confirm.title: Add {name}
discovery_confirm.description: Connect directly to this gateway. The MAC address is filled automatically when detected; otherwise you can optionally enter it manually.

reconfigure.title: Change gateway address
reconfigure.description: The address must belong to the same gateway.

error.invalid_input: Enter a valid hostname/IPv4 address and, if supplied, a full MAC address.
error.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different gateway.

abort.cannot_connect: Unable to identify the discovered gateway.
abort.not_chain2gate: This is not a Chain2Gate service.
